content: I take it you weren't issued any inhibitors, either.

speaker: Injured Soldier
content: Er... inhibitors?

speaker: Guard
content: Nine, I think they're all Infected.

raw: [name="Injured Soldier"]I-It can't be! I just got a physical one week ago, and I was in perfect health!
speaker: Injured Soldier
content: I-It can't be! I just got a physical one week ago, and I was in perfect health!

raw: [name="Nine"]One week... could be a rapid onset. Or they lied to you to keep you on the front lines.
speaker: Nine
content: One week... could be a rapid onset. Or they lied to you to keep you on the front lines.

speaker: Angry NCO
content: Shut up!

raw: [name="Nine"]How long have the ones on the stretchers been unconscious? They're in critical condition.
speaker: Nine
content: How long have the ones on the stretchers been unconscious? They're in critical condition.

speaker: Injured Soldier
content: Wh-What?

raw: [name="Nine"]Death and disintegration from acute condition is dangerous to both you and us.
speaker: Nine
content: Death and disintegration from acute condition is dangerous to both you and us.

raw: [name="Nine"]You were right to have the unconscious lying face-up on the stretchers, to prevent suffocation.
speaker: Nine
content: You were right to have the unconscious lying face-up on the stretchers, to prevent suffocation.

speaker: Nine
content: But... did you check their backs?

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Suddenly silent, the sergeant walks towards the stretcher, as though trying to turn the man lying on it over, but withdraws his hand as soon as it touches the soldier.", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Suddenly silent, the sergeant walks towards the stretcher, as though trying to turn the man lying on it over, but withdraws his hand as soon as it touches the soldier.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe sergeant looks helpless, like he's facing a deadly tuskbeast that could spit lightning and poison, one that could leap at him at any moment.",block = true)]
text: \nThe sergeant looks helpless, like he's facing a deadly tuskbeast that could spit lightning and poison, one that could leap at him at any moment.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nBut the man is his comrade. Before they were comrades, they might have been cousins, tilling the same piece of land together.",block = true)]
text: \nBut the man is his comrade. Before they were comrades, they might have been cousins, tilling the same piece of land together.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I sigh and sit the unconscious Victorian soldier up.", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I sigh and sit the unconscious Victorian soldier up.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThere is no need to remove his jacket. Originium crystals have pierced the clothing on his back.",block = true)]
text: \nThere is no need to remove his jacket. Originium crystals have pierced the clothing on his back.

speaker: Angry NCO
content: Heavens...

speaker: Injured Soldier
content: Victor! Damn it!

raw: [name="Injured Soldier"]I shouldn't have taken him along... his dad would kill him, then kill me, if he learned that his son was Infected!
speaker: Injured Soldier
content: I shouldn't have taken him along... his dad would kill him, then kill me, if he learned that his son was Infected!

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]Those Sarkaz used witchcraft to infect us! I knew it! It's the devil's curse!
speaker: Angry NCO
content: Those Sarkaz used witchcraft to infect us! I knew it! It's the devil's curse!

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]It's not enough that they defiled our land, now they want to defile our souls too!
speaker: Angry NCO
content: It's not enough that they defiled our land, now they want to defile our souls too!

speaker: Guard
content: That's enough.

raw: [name="Guard"]Sarkaz are naturally susceptible to Infection, and their soldiers are overwhelmingly Infected. When you kill them, or when you get Infected and they kill you...
speaker: Guard
content: Sarkaz are naturally susceptible to Infection, and their soldiers are overwhelmingly Infected. When you kill them, or when you get Infected and they kill you...

raw: [name="Guard"]If there's no one to clean up the bodies...
speaker: Guard
content: If there's no one to clean up the bodies...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I said no more. I heard a sound.", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I said no more. I heard a sound.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIt's a familiar sound, whether in Rim Billiton, Rhodes Island, or here and now.",block = true)]
text: \nIt's a familiar sound, whether in Rim Billiton, Rhodes Island, or here and now.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe sound that every Infected fears most.",block = true)]
text: \nThe sound that every Infected fears most.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe sound of us shattering.",block = true)]
text: \nThe sound of us shattering.

raw: [name="Injured Soldier"]I've heard... sounds... in the trenches...
speaker: Injured Soldier
content: I've heard... sounds... in the trenches...

raw: [name="Injured Soldier"]You told me it was artillery, Sergeant!
speaker: Injured Soldier
content: You told me it was artillery, Sergeant!

speaker: Angry NCO
content: It was artillery!

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]Our enemy will use anything and everything to destroy us and our country, including their own deaths!
speaker: Angry NCO
content: Our enemy will use anything and everything to destroy us and our country, including their own deaths!

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]Devils, bandits, Tarans... there was none of this crap during His Majesty Frederick III's reign!
speaker: Angry NCO
content: Devils, bandits, Tarans... there was none of this crap during His Majesty Frederick III's reign!

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]We... we must expel this scum from Victoria... we...
speaker: Angry NCO
content: We... we must expel this scum from Victoria... we...

speaker: Angry NCO
content: We...

raw: [name="Angry NCO"]What can we do? Can we save Victor? We... we dwell in the blessing of glorious Victoria...
speaker: Angry NCO
content: What can we do? Can we save Victor? We... we dwell in the blessing of glorious Victoria...

speaker: Guard
content: What an idiot.

raw: [name="Guard"]I'll say this again. You're an Infected. Very Infected.
speaker: Guard
content: I'll say this again. You're an Infected. Very Infected.

raw: [name="Guard"]In case this isn't clear to you, like us, like everyone else here...
speaker: Guard
content: In case this isn't clear to you, like us, like everyone else here...

speaker: Guard
content: You're going to die.
